title: Congressman witnesses ODNI official apologizing to David Grusch for his treatment
place_text: unspecified (meeting with the Office of the Director of National Intelligence)

tellings.quote: I got to see a meeting happen between Grush and um some someone from the O from OD and I that was a pretty blunt meeting where he had he was and and you could tell they were basically apologizing for the way in which he was he's been treated over the years.

plain: A US congressman named Eric Burlison says that in 2026 he sat in on a blunt meeting between David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has spoken out about hidden UFO programs, and someone from the ODNI, the office that oversees all US intelligence agencies. Burlison tells Michels that, from what he saw, the official was basically apologizing for how Grusch had been treated over the years. If so, it would mean the intelligence world was admitting it had treated Grusch badly.
